_readme: S730 subject-title hunt (Sam, 2026-11-25: the printed local subject titles decide each local code's common subject and unblock the 88 stray M-ID codes, r-no-mid-on-a-stray-code-sam-2026-11-25). Pass 3 of this plan (pass 2 read run 45625671325): pass 2 printed the department headers (once each) but took a program list's course mention for a code's first course. This read keeps a course heading only where a Units: or Hours: line follows within four lines, credit (ADMJUS 101) and noncredit (NC.APE-002) alike, and prints the twelve lines above each code's first course. No model call.

questions.subject_titles: The catalog's printed heading (or prefix legend entry) for each course subject code.
